mapper.select: SELECT * FROM `admin` WHERE username = #{username} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM `admin` WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT id, username, name, phone, status, create_time, update_time FROM `admin` WHERE ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `admin` (username, password, name, phone, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE `admin` SET password = #{password}, update_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{id}
